mode: Built-in image generation for photographic artwork; deterministic SVG composition for controlled grouping comparisons.

sources.name: chunk-garden-supper-photo
sources.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: photographic banner for a believable community garden supper invitation. Primary request: a modest communal outdoor supper table in a leafy greenhouse courtyard at early evening, simple ceramic bowls, metal spoons, bread and shared vegetable dishes, ordinary wooden furniture and a few understated warm string lights. Inviting local community atmosphere with realistic materials and soft natural evening light, not luxury hospitality or commercial stock-photo glamour. No people, no hands, readable writing, menus, signs, logos or watermarks. Edge-to-edge editorial photograph only, not a poster, page or layout. Landscape 3:2, composed to retain the set table and garden setting in a shallow wide banner crop.

comparisonPolicy: Supper invitation preserves all six fact strings and their typography, changes only their baselines and adds three semantic headings. Booking screen preserves all activity/date/place values and styling, replacing field-type headings with two activity-based groups and boundaries. Collection notice changes only two separator spaces within the displayed identifier; all characters, styles, positions, imagery/crops, palette and presentation otherwise remain fixed.
